messages:
sarah: FYI ACME-prod has been getting 429s from the dedicated pool since ~17:05 UTC after they migrated plans. Several tenants affected, intermittent but widespread. sample request id: rq_7a2f9.

kevin: Can you paste an example 429 and any autoscaler/agent logs around that time? Is this latency or strict rate limiting?

sarah: 429 body we got: `{"error":"rate_limited","message":"per-tenant rate limit exceeded","retry_after":30}`. Headers: `x-rate-limit-unit: minute`, `x-tenant-id: acme-prod-123`. From gateway logs: `status=429 tenant=acme-prod-123 pool=dedicated-us-east-2 request_id=rq_7a2f9 tokens=12`.

juan: Looking at the quota bindings for that tenant — the plan migration script wrote `units: 3600` and `unit: minute` instead of `unit: second` for per-second mapping. So effective rate is 60x lower than expected. Autoscaler didn't kick because CPU/mem looked healthy (requests were being rejected early by rate layer).

anya: Repro steps I used on a staging mirror: 1) switch tenant to migrated plan 2) spin up concurrent clients (100 rps) 3) observe immediate 429s from the quota proxy. Quick fix: bump tenant quota or flip unit back.

kevin: Confirmed — quota-migration job had a bug interpreting the legacy `qps` -> `units` mapping. Prioritizing hotfix. If we revert the plan mapping for affected tenants traffic should flow and autoscale can react normally.

ops-bot: deploy-bot posted: "job/quota-migration v2026.3.18 deployed by infra-ci — rollouts started at 16:58 UTC"

juan: Recommended emergency action: run admin API to patch the tenant mapping:
```
PATCH /admin/v1/tenants/acme-prod-123/quota
{ "rate": 600, "unit": "second" }
```
That will restore expected throughput. I'm going to script a bulk patch for the 8 tenants with the same tag.

sarah: Applying manual patch to acme-prod-123 now. I'll also open a support post to let customer know root cause and ETA.

anya: For roll back: revert the migration job OR add a post-apply validation that checks per-tenant effective rps against previous value.

kevin: After patch, we should also force an immediate autoscale evaluation: `POST /infra/v1/pools/dedicated-us-east-2/refresh-autoscaler` to let new traffic shape trigger node spin-up.

ops-bot: ops-bot: job/infra-trigger refresh-autoscaler started by kevin — id af3b2c

sarah: Patch applied to affected tenants (8 total). After refresh we see no new 429s for acme-prod-123 for the last 5 mins. Monitoring dashboard: request success rate improved from 84% -> 99%.

juan: I'll follow up with a small migration patch to enforce unit normalization (`unit` forced to either `second` or `minute` with conversion) and add an integrity check to the migration job.

kevin: Please create an incident ticket and postmortem. Add action items: 1) revert bug in migration job 2) add unit normalization test 3) run a sweep to detect other tenants with suspicious unit ratios 4) add alert on `effective_rps` delta > 2x post-migration.

anya: Customer notified with apology and summary. They've accepted workaround and will monitor.

sarah: Thanks team — keeping the thread open until we ship the migration fix.
